entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: The planet's flux densities in JWST/NIRCam F460M, F430M and F410M, 64.5, 72.6 and 164.6 µJy (Balmer et al. 2025, Table 2), drive red, green and blue. The result, #6e75aa, is infrared false colour, not what an eye would see, and one colour for the whole disc.
